propositions: Models wrap quoted JSON in markdown fences, allowing schema-valid decoys outside the fence to win over the actual payload, even with schema filtering

An explicit line-anchored sentinel marker channel (<<<REBAR_OUTPUT>>> / <<<END>>>) makes the payload location a stated contract, enabling deterministic last-block-wins extraction independent of the selection pipeline's internal ordering
The bounded-retry fail-closed prompt must instruct the same marker channel as the first attempt; current retry wording omits markers and instructs bare JSON, contradicting the first-attempt directive

Markerless replies and incomplete marker blocks (opening marker with no closing marker) must fall back to full-reply schema-filtered selection byte-for-byte identical to today's behavior, preserving backward compatibility

Marker extraction must apply per-block tolerant json-repair (trailing commas, unclosed braces, smart quotes) but must fail-closed (raise the last block's error) if no marker block validates, never falling through to decoys outside the markers

The directive lead-in, compact schema JSON, and sentinel marker wording must be single-sourced as one module constant so exactly one string is used by schema_directive, the marker extractor, and the measurement harness with no drift
